text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. A successful app requires careful planning, from the initial idea to the final release. One of the first decisions is whether to build a native app for a single platform, like iOS or Android, or to use a cross-platform approach to share code between them. While native apps often offer better performance, cross-platform tools can save time and money. Once the app is built, it must be submitted to app stores like the Apple App Store or Google Play, which have strict review guidelines. Finally, a responsive design is crucial, ensuring the user interface looks great and works smoothly on different screen sizes and devices.
